# Sudip Niroula

> Full stack software engineer based in Birtamod, Nepal. Builds web
> applications with Python and FastAPI on the backend and Next.js on the
> front, with PostgreSQL. Open to remote work.

Contact: sudipniroula5@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/imsudip45
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/sudipniroula45
CV: https://www.sudipniroula.com.np/cv.pdf

## Experience

- Full Stack Engineer, Nullion Technologies, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania (remote,
  May 2026 to present). Backend and
  frontend work on Align Care Hub and Align Care DODD (SaaS for US home care
  agencies), a bookkeeping platform for small businesses, the Ohio WebCheck
  fingerprint scheduler, the Zoe's Beer marketplace, and the Cafe 8848
  ordering app (iOS and Android). FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Flutter.
- Software Engineer, FutureFrame (February 2025 to March 2026). Built Football
  Score Pro, a PySide6 desktop app for running match broadcasts, and Football
  Score Lite, an Electron app for live match graphics.
- Technical Lead (contract, remote), Seabirds Pictures, Lisbon (July to August
  2025). Built web applications with Django REST Framework and Next.js.

## Education

BSc in Computer Science and Information Technology, Mechi Multiple Campus,
Tribhuvan University, Nepal (2022 to 2026), First Division.

## Technologies

Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, FastAPI, Django REST Framework, Node.js,
Next.js, React, PySide6, Electron, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, Google Cloud,
CI/CD, Git, LangChain, Gemini API.

## Projects

- [Persona](https://github.com/tmgnisc/Ai-builder-cup): e-commerce platform with
  an AI shopping companion, Pip, that moves around the page with the shopper,
  compares products and hands work to a small team of AI sub-agents. Team
  project for the AI Builder Cup.
- [Labhya Compute](https://github.com/imsudip45/Labya_compute): marketplace for
  renting out idle GPUs. Hosts run a desktop app that starts a Docker container
  and opens a reverse SSH tunnel to a relay server. Backend later rewritten in
  FastAPI. College project, team of three. Most Innovative Project, Ambition
  Hackathon 2025.
- [Fingerprint](https://github.com/imsudip45/Fingerprint): tutor children can
  talk to, built on the Gemini Live API, with a planner that decides when to
  show a picture, give a quiz or read a worksheet the child shares.
- [Align Care Hub](https://aligncarehub.com/) and Align Care DODD: SaaS for US
  home care agencies (Nullion Technologies).
- [Ohio WebCheck Scheduler](https://fingerprint.nulliontech.com/): booking
  system for Ohio BCI and FBI fingerprint background checks across four
  locations (Nullion Technologies).
- [Zoe's Beer](https://zoesbeer.com/): craft beer marketplace with inventory
  management (Nullion Technologies).
- [Cafe 8848](https://cafe8848pa.com/): ordering and loyalty platform for a
  coffee shop in Brentwood, Pennsylvania, on iOS and Android (Nullion
  Technologies).
- [Football Score Pro](https://github.com/imsudip45/football-score-pro): PySide6 desktop
  software for running a football match broadcast, with a FastAPI match API
  that keeps a web match-control dashboard in sync over WebSockets
  (FutureFrame).
- [Football Score Lite](https://github.com/imsudip45/football-score-lite):
  Electron and Next.js app that pushes live match graphics to OBS over
  WebSockets (FutureFrame).
- [LiteRT.js Classifier](https://imsudip45.github.io/litert-image-classifier/):
  in-browser image classification on WebGPU with a GPU versus CPU latency
  benchmark.
- [Rustle](https://github.com/imsudip45/rustle): Windows search launcher written
  in Rust, with fuzzy matching and parallel indexing using Rayon.

## Writing

- [Token-Efficient Extraction of Text from Screenshots](https://www.sudipniroula.com.np/notes/token-efficient-screenshot-extraction.html):
  a survey of the gap between visual-token-compression research and exact text
  extraction.
